description:
My Property Box are delighted to market this seven double bedroom Student Property available Summer 2024 at £135pppw.

Impressive student house in East Jesmond with good size living room, separate kitchen and dining room, two bathrooms. The property benefits from solar panels being installed, so tenants will get the benefit of cheaper electricity bills. All rooms are a generous size so no box room that nobody wants! This is rare in a property of this size so early viewing is recommended as we expect this to go quickly. To arrange a viewing contact MPB and speak to the Lettings Team.
